value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical cubic symmetric graph with a previously known minimum forcing number six. An exact complete classification shows 180 inclusion-minimal 7-sets and 780 8-sets, an interesting failure of well-forcedness by two ranks; it also supplies the complete natural dual obstruction antichain of 830 minimal forts and orbit representatives under all 120 graph symmetries. These are nontrivial finite structural invariants of use as examples and verification instances, not a textbook substitution or the already known minimum.
